description: Start an AI agent run in an isolated sandbox and return the run (status queued) at once. Give a prompt, or the name of a saved workflow. Poll with get_run or block with wait_for_run for the result. Every run has a cost cap (max_cost_micros) and a timeout, and is billed to the organization of the API key. Connections must already be saved in the organization; reference them by name. Use idempotency_key to make a retry safe. A run's cost_micros is provisional (usually above the final cost) until cost_final is true; see get_run. On the hosted service a run costs a run fee once its worker starts, compute per second, model calls at the provider's price plus a percentage, and web requests and searches at flat prices; `GET /v1/me` reports the rates.

allowed_methods.description: HTTP methods allowed, for example ["GET"] for read-only access.

allowed_tools.description: Tool names allowed on an MCP connection.

ref.description: Name of the saved connection (see list_connections).

connections.description: Saved connections the agent may use, keyed by the name the agent sees. Each refers to a connection saved in the organization and can only narrow it.

description.description: What the workflow does and what input it expects, in a sentence or two, for people and agents. At most 500 characters.

files.description: Files placed in the sandbox: inline content, or a file saved in the organization.

file.description: Id of a saved file (instead of content).

path.description: Where the file appears in the sandbox.

idempotency_key.description: A retry with the same key returns the original run instead of starting another.

input.description: Any JSON the agent receives as its input. If the workflow has an input_schema, it must match.

input_schema.description: A JSON Schema (draft 2020-12 or 7, at most 32 KiB, no references to other documents) that this run's input must match. A run whose input does not match is refused with the path and the reason, such as "input.city: required".

max_cost_micros.description: Cost cap in millionths of a dollar. The run stops at the cap.

model.description: A model id from list_models. Omit for the default.

output_schema.description: A JSON Schema (draft 2020-12 or 7, at most 32 KiB, no references to other documents) that this run's output must match. The agent is told the schema and asked to reply with JSON only; the output is then checked, and a run whose output does not match fails with the reason.

prompt.description: What the agent should do. Required unless workflow is set.

shell.description: Whether the agent may run shell commands in its sandbox.

web.description: Web access: true, false, or an object limiting it.

allow.description: Domains the agent may fetch, such as "api.github.com" or "*.example.com". Empty allows every public domain.

search.description: Whether web search is available (default true).

workflow.description: Name of a saved workflow to run instead of a prompt (see list_workflows).

zero_data_retention.description: Record nothing of the run's content; the output is kept only briefly and released on first retrieval.

name: create_run
title: Create a run
